accounting_definitions.gadget_carries: carries by players whose position is not QB / RB / FB
accounting_definitions.other_bucket: every allocation keeps an explicit OTHER bucket (unseen / non-candidate players)
accounting_definitions.team_attempts: sum of player-line pass attempts (player-line accounting differs from raw distinct pass plays by sd ~4 attempts, mean 0: documented data noise)
accounting_definitions.team_carries_for_allocation: sum of player-line carries of the target game (equals raw rush plays on average; sd ~1 carry)
accounting_definitions.team_receptions_for_allocation: max(sum of receptions, raw team completions)

iteration: candidates are compared by phase1b_harness (D1-D4); every rejected variant is appended to phase1b_failed_experiments.json
shared_state_v2: team accumulators: completions, rush yards, completion yards, interceptions, sacks, red-zone plays, offensive TDs (rush + receiving, where player lines exist), same B0 blend; opponent allowed / forced mirrors (cfb_phase1_team_environment.TEAM_FEATURES_V2)
player raw count windows over the last 20 appearances, all-team (RS.L20_FEATURES)
play-event tables (events_{season}.jsonl.gz): per-carry yards, per-pass kind / yards / receiver with the QB-receiver swap fix; dev loaders request seasons <= 2024 only
target_valid_rule: player-row evaluations exclude target games failing the play-coverage validity rule (consistent with phase 1 amendment 1; Phase 1 P1 / O1 results are unchanged on record)
